name: SUPREME substep and enhancement details (extends supreme-sampler)
plain: Details the first pass left out, from a full read of the function up to the final step cases. Substeps all restart from the same x and are averaged, so they only differ through the history term or a differing substep method. The denoised enhancement runs inside every model call, including RK stages, with strength divided by the expected calls per step.
math:
For k substeps: z_k=x, step, z_avg+=(1/k)z_k. Weights are uniform; the ⅙,⅔,⅙ table is only for adaptive_rk.
After the average: x=z_avg+noise_mod(σ↑).
Error for dynamic: e=‖d(x_pred,D)−d₋₁‖/‖d₋₁‖ with x_pred an Euler step from the previous x. e<.01→order 6 (rkf45), <.0375→4, <.075→3, <.15→2, else 1. Step 0 uses rkf45.
Enhance per call, n=calls per step: D+=(unsharp(D)−D)(σᵢ−σᵢ₊₁)E/n + (jointbilateral(x,D)−x)(σᵢ−σᵢ₊₁)E/n.
Centralize per channel: D−=mean·c/n·√σ. Normalize: D+=(D/std−D)·N/n·√σ.
Perp-hist: a=x−(D−x), b=x−(D₋₁−x), b⊥=b−a·Σ(a b)/‖a‖², D+=(p/n)·b⊥.
Final step always euler.
label: from code
surprise: The substep noise is added to z_k after z_avg was already accumulated and z_k is reset next substep, so the inner noise never reaches the output; it only advances the noise sampler.
